name: Abashiri (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Abashiri city emblem in white: a large five-pointed star bearing a red ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Abashiri, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 29 July 1968; the emblem dates from 22 March 1940.
